0013ecdd6cce.en: A village east of Sanbi. Its blacksmiths, a father and son, suck at their job.
0013ecdd6cce.t: Desa di timur Sanbi. Pandai besinya, seorang ayah dan anaknya, payah dalam pekerjaan mereka.

076779d7d8cc.en: A small village by two rivers. It floods every spring, so every house is built off the ground.
076779d7d8cc.t: Desa kecil di tepi dua sungai. Desa ini banjir setiap musim semi, jadi setiap rumah dibangun di atas panggung.

0de63bd59d9f.en: A village west of Northpoint, founded by someone who was nearly the Lishies' food, though it never grew much, for whatever reason. It has a lighthouse.
0de63bd59d9f.t: Desa di barat Northpoint, didirikan oleh seseorang yang nyaris menjadi makanan para Lishies, meski desa ini tak pernah berkembang besar, entah kenapa. Desa ini punya mercusuar.

1600c59ad2d1.en: A village not too far from Forway City, where Harry and Dalila got on a wagon. It's called Jack Wood because its early residents were famous for robbing travelers by blocking the road with trees (hijack, jack).
1600c59ad2d1.t: Desa yang tidak terlalu jauh dari Forway City, tempat Harry dan Dalila naik gerobak. Namanya Jack Wood karena penduduk awalnya terkenal merampok para pengelana dengan menghalangi jalan memakai pohon (hijack, jack).

2c39e4cf0e6c.en: Summary written by AI from the author's notes (Villages.md). AI disclosure
2c39e4cf0e6c.t: Ringkasan ditulis oleh AI dari catatan penulis (Villages.md). Pengungkapan AI

2cd87c6f70bd.en: A village north of Sanbi. Sometimes saltwater and water from the waterfall mix in the harbor and make the water light up. It has a lighthouse.
2cd87c6f70bd.t: Desa di utara Sanbi. Kadang air asin dan air dari air terjun bercampur di pelabuhan dan membuat airnya menyala. Desa ini punya mercusuar.

35ecd1f08177.en: A village east of Sanbi. The village chief, Tupinamba, is old and cranky but realistic: when he says something is shit, it's because it is. He seems about as old as Gabiro, but a bit fatter and taller.
35ecd1f08177.t: Desa di timur Sanbi. Kepala desanya, Tupinamba, sudah tua dan pemarah tapi realistis: kalau ia bilang sesuatu tahi, itu karena memang begitu. Ia tampak kira-kira setua Gabiro, tapi sedikit lebih gemuk dan lebih tinggi.

3cf7066fe8f0.en: It floods every spring, as the river flow changes and the snow melts, so every house is built off the ground.
3cf7066fe8f0.t: Desa ini banjir setiap musim semi, saat aliran sungai berubah dan salju mencair, jadi setiap rumah dibangun di atas panggung.

41e6b1c41ef1.en: A village next to Bahyum; see Bahyum under Land for more, including the castle mood tracker.
41e6b1c41ef1.t: Desa di sebelah Bahyum; lihat Bahyum di bagian Wilayah untuk selengkapnya, termasuk papan pantauan suasana hati kastil.

4f75c386ee02.en: A really old village in the middle of nowhere. There's a fair amount of inbreeding.
4f75c386ee02.t: Desa yang sangat tua di antah-berantah. Cukup banyak perkawinan sedarah.

58b46653244f.en: Usually one or two people in this "village", who dare to stay isolated long enough to get rich. Its lighthouse keeps boats from straying too far northeast by accident, and boats coming from Newland from going too far south.
58b46653244f.t: Biasanya satu atau dua orang di "desa" ini, yang berani hidup terisolasi cukup lama untuk menjadi kaya. Mercusuarnya mencegah perahu tanpa sengaja melenceng terlalu jauh ke timur laut, dan perahu dari Newland melenceng terlalu jauh ke selatan.

5b7dc6d64e31.en: A village on the left edge of Endlessfog Island. It has a lighthouse.
5b7dc6d64e31.t: Desa di tepi kiri Pulau Endlessfog. Desa ini punya mercusuar.

5f8f9e1f2bb7.en: A small village on Ganyrami Bay. It has a lighthouse.
5f8f9e1f2bb7.t: Desa kecil di Ganyrami Bay. Desa ini punya mercusuar.

63056165b37d.en: A village on the island on the other side: the goal for many, a long time ago, as they fled the Lishies' hungry mouths.
63056165b37d.t: Desa di pulau di seberang: tujuan banyak orang, dulu sekali, saat mereka kabur dari mulut lapar para Lishies.

6fc4cc7dea18.en: A village between Sanbi and Forway. Back in the day, crossing the river was a must, so a village grew around this resting point. The village elder, Tomanius, is a caring older guy. The bridge is four times as long as the reference, a bit like the one in Skyrim.
6fc4cc7dea18.t: Desa di antara Sanbi dan Forway. Dulu, menyeberangi sungai adalah keharusan, jadi sebuah desa tumbuh di sekitar tempat istirahat ini. Tetua desanya, Tomanius, adalah pria tua yang penuh perhatian. Jembatannya empat kali sepanjang yang di gambar referensi, agak mirip yang di Skyrim.

72d405bed437.en: A village southeast of Forway, near Likenia.
72d405bed437.t: Desa di tenggara Forway, dekat Likenia.

77eeb2f03e9d.en: 45 more entries on this page are only in <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Behind The Scenes</button>.
77eeb2f03e9d.t: 45 entri lain di halaman ini hanya ada di <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Di Balik Layar</button>.

8028cee75734.en: A village east of Sanbi, not far from where Eori kept Harry hostage. The basement of Eori's hideout:
8028cee75734.t: Desa di timur Sanbi, tak jauh dari tempat Eori menyandera Harry. Ruang bawah tanah tempat persembunyian Eori:

86ac5f42203c.en: The small places between the cities, grouped by region: Freeish, Gandew, Tolerideme, Sanbi and beyond. Each entry says why the village exists and what it is known for. Banhia feeds travelers on the road between Forway and Deltacross, Cliffbay keeps a lighthouse, and Fiera's Hut is famous for pies made from recipes passed down for generations.
86ac5f42203c.t: Tempat-tempat kecil di antara kota, dikelompokkan menurut wilayah: Freeish, Gandew, Tolerideme, Sanbi, dan seterusnya. Setiap entri menyebutkan alasan desa itu ada dan apa yang membuatnya terkenal. Banhia memberi makan para pelancong di jalan antara Forway dan Deltacross, Cliffbay menjaga mercusuar, dan Fiera's Hut terkenal dengan pai dari resep turun-temurun.

8727397a503e.en: Emelia: a curvy blonde woman in a brown corset, white blouse and short blue skirt.
8727397a503e.t: Emelia: seorang wanita berambut cokelat bertubuh sintal dengan korset cokelat, blus putih, dan rok biru pendek.

8e7c1c5547fc.en: North of Tolerideme. Wood People are forced into place, forming a wall with Fost Stone.
8e7c1c5547fc.t: Di utara Tolerideme. Wood People dipaksa di tempatnya, membentuk tembok dengan Batu Fost.

8f687d534f83.en: A village near Flatland, where a bandit group used broken weapons in their attacks, until adventurers flattened them a long time ago.
8f687d534f83.t: Desa dekat Flatland, tempat sekelompok bandit memakai senjata rusak dalam serangan mereka, sampai para petualang menumpas mereka sejak lama.

968f0599653f.en: A village south of Sanbi. It has a lighthouse.
968f0599653f.t: Desa di selatan Sanbi. Desa ini punya mercusuar.

976739e9be2b.en: A small village off Deltacross. It has a Gandew lighthouse.
976739e9be2b.t: Desa kecil di lepas Deltacross. Desa ini punya mercusuar Gandew.

a56c76274353.en: An old lady, Fiera, took care of every passerby, whatever their origin or destination, and some like-minded people decided to stay and help strangers too.
a56c76274353.t: Seorang wanita tua, Fiera, merawat setiap orang yang lewat, apa pun asal atau tujuannya, dan sebagian orang yang sepemikiran memutuskan tinggal dan ikut membantu orang asing.

a7972ad7eb55.en: A village near where two rivers meet, for people who wanted a peaceful life, but not too far from civilization.
a7972ad7eb55.t: Desa dekat pertemuan dua sungai, untuk orang-orang yang menginginkan hidup damai, tapi tidak terlalu jauh dari peradaban.

a8bdbf7926eb.en: Arukia in Arc 1: two outfits of a brown-haired young woman, a black-and-blue maid dress and a casual blue top with a purple skirt.
a8bdbf7926eb.t: Arukia di Arc 1: dua pakaian seorang wanita muda berambut cokelat, gaun pelayan hitam dan biru serta pakaian biru santai dengan rok ungu.

aa99df9d1268.en: A village east of Sanbi, south of Green Sea. The village chief, Manbola, is an old lady who's chill with everything, just living life.
aa99df9d1268.t: Desa di timur Sanbi, di selatan Green Sea. Kepala desanya, Manbola, adalah wanita tua yang santai menghadapi segala hal, sekadar menjalani hidup.

bfaff2cad3b8.en: A village on the north point of the bay. It has a lighthouse.
bfaff2cad3b8.t: Desa di ujung utara teluk. Desa ini punya mercusuar.

c19eb1696359.en: The small places between the cities, grouped by region: Freeish, Gandew, Tolerideme, Sanbi and beyond.
c19eb1696359.t: Tempat-tempat kecil di antara kota, dikelompokkan menurut wilayah: Freeish, Gandew, Tolerideme, Sanbi, dan seterusnya.

c85613d7f49b.en: A village quite far from Forway City, which Harry and Dalila passed through. Nailah, Severino and Vitor live here. Since it's deep in the forest, the village is fortified with walls.
c85613d7f49b.t: Desa yang cukup jauh dari Forway City, yang dilewati Harry dan Dalila. Nailah, Severino, dan Vitor tinggal di sini. Karena letaknya jauh di dalam hutan, desa ini dibentengi tembok.

cc3de8998411.en: A village under Tolerideme's "protection", acting like an extension of the kingdom.
cc3de8998411.t: Desa di bawah "perlindungan" Tolerideme, bertindak seperti perpanjangan kerajaan.

cd8fa1407db5.en: Food: Fiera's baked pies, from recipes passed down through the generations. Deliciously moist.
cd8fa1407db5.t: Makanan: pai panggang buatan Fiera, dari resep turun-temurun. Lembap dan lezat.

d21cfc6ea7ab.en: A small village where the Ganyrami water meets the ocean. It has a lighthouse. It looks almost eerily identical to Cocona Island: people who visit one are often honestly confused by how much it looks like the other.
d21cfc6ea7ab.t: Desa kecil tempat air Ganyrami bertemu laut. Desa ini punya mercusuar. Rupanya nyaris identik secara ganjil dengan Cocona Island: orang yang mengunjungi salah satunya sering benar-benar bingung betapa miripnya dengan yang lain.

d7018b5be1b1.en: Cocona: a palm tree with rainbow-colored fronds and several colorful nut-like fruits.
d7018b5be1b1.t: Cocona: pohon palem dengan pelepah berwarna pelangi dan beberapa buah warna-warni mirip kacang.

d77003e40ffb.en: A village on the skinny part of the island. Nobody knows why the name Sandwich stuck.
d77003e40ffb.t: Desa di bagian pulau yang sempit. Tak ada yang tahu kenapa nama Sandwich melekat.

da39c22fbdeb.en: Not a very inventive name, but quite descriptive and honest. It has a lighthouse.
da39c22fbdeb.t: Bukan nama yang sangat kreatif, tapi cukup deskriptif dan jujur. Desa ini punya mercusuar.

e033a9eeda62.en: A small village where the Ganyrami water meets the ocean. It has a lighthouse. It looks almost eerily identical to Cliffbay: people who visit one are often honestly confused by how much it looks like the other.
e033a9eeda62.t: Desa kecil tempat air Ganyrami bertemu laut. Desa ini punya mercusuar. Rupanya nyaris identik secara ganjil dengan Cliffbay: orang yang mengunjungi salah satunya sering benar-benar bingung betapa miripnya dengan yang lain.

e52eb75108eb.en: A village near the road between Forway and Deltacross, serving people traveling through. Lots of small restaurants sell tons of food to go.
e52eb75108eb.t: Desa di dekat jalan antara Forway dan Deltacross, melayani orang-orang yang lewat. Banyak restoran kecil yang menjual banyak sekali makanan untuk dibawa pulang.

e7b9ac5f977c.en: Nailah's family: a dark-haired woman in a long cream dress (marked with an arrow), a small blond boy and a long-haired blond man with a blade.
e7b9ac5f977c.t: Keluarga Nailah: seorang wanita berambut gelap dengan gaun krem panjang (ditandai panah), seorang anak laki-laki kecil berambut cokelat, dan seorang pria berambut cokelat panjang yang memegang pisau.

ec4b26cfed2e.en: Tolerideme Winga: a pink parrot-like bird with red wings and a feathered crest, perched on a branch.
ec4b26cfed2e.t: Winga Tolerideme: burung merah muda mirip kakaktua dengan sayap merah dan jambul berbulu, bertengger di dahan.

eefb5803b16c.en: Itanema: a pale woman with long black hair in a black-and-blue dress and tall boots.
eefb5803b16c.t: Itanema: seorang wanita pucat berambut hitam panjang dengan gaun hitam dan biru serta sepatu bot tinggi.
